consequence.statement: Bug fix: a refreshed ApplicationSet is reconciled once instead of repeatedly; no operator action is stated.

original.statement: ApplicationSet controller now reconciles an ApplicationSet only once when it is refreshed (bug fix).

decision.reason: [ev-bda8048cc6c3] lists this only as a bug fix: an ApplicationSet is now reconciled once when it is refreshed. It says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs operator action. Removing duplicate reconciles is not a new behaviour that operators need to check, so the proposed consequence "none" (informational) fits. A failure kind or behavior-change would claim more than the evidence supports.
